parallels.note: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.

translations.web: You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter for your son.
translations.bsb: Do not intermarry with them. Do not give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons,
translations.kjv: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.
translations.asv: neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.
